english.title: Create false / misleading impression as to market in / price / value of relevant investments
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) did an act or engaged in a course of conduct, namely **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF ACT / CONDUCT..), which created a false or misleading impression as to the market in or the price or value of a relevant investment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RELEVANT INVESTMENT..), intending to create that impression

(A)_[and intending, by creating that impression, to induce another person to acquire, dispose of, subscribe for or underwrite the investments or to refrain from doing so or to exercise or refrain from exercising any rights conferred by the investments]_
(B)_[when you knew that the impression was false or misleading or were reckless as to whether it was, and intending, by creating the impression, to make a gain for yourself or another, or cause a loss to another person or expose another person to the risk of loss]_
(C)_[when you knew that the impression was false or misleading or were reckless as to whether it was, and you were aware that creating the impression was likely to result in the making of a gain for yourself or another, or the causing of a loss to another person or the exposing of another person to the risk of loss]_
(D)_[and intending, by creating that impression, to induce another person to acquire, dispose of, subscribe for or underwrite the investments or to refrain from doing so or to exercise or refrain from exercising any rights conferred by the investments when you knew that the impression was false or misleading or were reckless as to whether it was, and intending, by creating the impression, to make a gain for yourself or another, or cause a loss to another person or expose another person to the risk of loss]_
(E)_[and intending, by creating that impression, to induce another person to acquire, dispose of, subscribe for or underwrite the investments or to refrain from doing so or to exercise or refrain from exercising any rights conferred by the investments when you knew that the impression was false or misleading or were reckless as to whether it was, and you were aware that creating the impression was likely to result in the making of a gain for yourself or another, or the causing of a loss to another person or the exposing of another person to the risk of loss]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 90 and 92 of the Financial Services Act 2012.

english.notes:
(i) Investment includes any asset, right or interest.
(ii) Relevant agreement means an agreement -
(a) the entering into or performance of which by either party constitutes an activity of a kind specified in an order made by the Treasury, and (b) which relates to a relevant investment.
(iii) Relevant benchmark means a benchmark of a kind specified in an order made by the Treasury.
(iv) Relevant investment means an investment of a kind specified in an order made by the Treasury.
(v) Gain and loss extend only to gain or loss in money or other property of any kind and include such gain or loss whether temporary or permanent.
(vi) Gain includes a gain by keeping what one has, as well as a gain by getting what one does not have.
(vi) Loss includes a loss by not getting what one might get, as well as a loss by parting with what one has.
(viii) SI 2021/1173 amended the penalty for this offence with effect from 1st November 2021. For an offence that is committed before that date use this offence wording. For an offence that is committed on or after that date, see H23087.
(ix) Where an offence is found to be committed over a period of two or more days, or at some point during a period of two or more days, it is to be taken to have been committed on the first of those days, see section 31(4) of the Financial Services Act 2021.

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Note: The reference to 'Twelve months imprisonment' should be read as a reference to 'Six months imprisonment' until the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003. On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecution:
None
